description: Find "ANR in <package>" entries in logcat (system_server's standard signal for a hang), and try to also pull matching files from /data/anr/. The /data/anr/ read can fail with permission denied on a non-debuggable, production-signed physical device - that's a real platform restriction, not a bug, and the logcat-based result still comes back either way.
name: get_anr_trace
title: Get ANR Trace
